prompt:
EDIT the reference image(s). Keep this exact design identity — the silhouette language, colours, materials, lighting and 1-px near-black navy outline of:
A single giant mechanical spider fortress boss for a retro 16-bit side-scrolling space shooter, seen from slightly above in a three-quarter side view with its head toward the left, centered with a generous empty margin on the left, right and bottom, the whole machine fully visible with nothing cut off by the frame. All eight long jointed legs radiate outward around the body in a wide star-like spread, four reaching forward-left and four reaching back-right, each leg rising to a high sharp knee above the carapace and then plunging down to a needle-sharp steel tip, like a huge hunting spider poised to pounce. It hangs from exactly three thick glowing pale-gold silk cables that run straight up from its back to the top edge of the picture. A round domed carapace of sand-beige armor plate with dark gunmetal seams, rivets and orange hazard chevrons, and a big round armored abdomen behind it with spinneret vents trailing pale glowing threads. At the front a head with a cluster of eight glowing red sensor eyes and two large curved bronze fangs dripping pale glowing web, the obvious weak point. Menacing, sharp, readable silhouette. Crisp chunky pixel art with a clean dark navy outline, flat saturated fills with three-step shading ramps lit from the top-left, limited palette of sand beige, pale cream, gunmetal grey, bronze, burnt orange and red accents. Perfectly flat solid pure bright green chroma-key background, no gradient, no texture, no sand, no dunes, no scenery, no sky, no stars, no cast shadow, no glow bleeding onto the background, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no UI.

Rebuild it as a sprite sheet under this strict contract:
- On a CONTINUOUS flat pure bright green chroma-key background, exactly hex #51e018, identical solid colour in every background pixel: no gradient, no vignette, no shadow, no floor plane, no panel, no second green shade.- Every subject sits well inside the sheet: at least 48 px of unbroken flat #51e018 key between every subject and the nearest sheet border, and all four sheet corners are pure #51e018.
- SEVEN (7) equal square cells in ONE row of seven, one named cell per part, reading left to right in this exact order: 1 = HEAD (the widow's armored head with its eye cluster, facing left); 2 = FANG (one single cheliceral fang); 3 = SPINNERET (the silk spinner organ); 4 = EGG-SAC (the swollen amber egg sac); 5 = BODY (the abdomen+thorax core, facing left, NO legs attached, NO head fangs drawn on — a clean single part); 6 = LEG-TOP (one arched leg group seen from above); 7 = LEG-BOTTOM (one leg group seen from below, a vertical mirror cousin). All seven parts at the SAME scale, matching the referenced boss's navy-outline style. NO multi-part cells (never draw the whole spider again), NO unnamed extra cells, exactly SEVEN cells.
- The sheet canvas measures EXACTLY 1408×256 px. Produce EXACTLY 7 subject cells — no more, no fewer — and nothing else on the sheet.
- NO guide lines, NO cell borders, NO divider lines, NO frames, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers anywhere on the sheet — the cell names above are ordering instructions and must NEVER be drawn.
- Style: retro 16-bit pixel art, chunky visible square pixels, flat saturated fills with a three-step shading ramp lit from the top-left, crisp 1-px near-black navy outline on every silhouette edge, no anti-aliasing, no soft gradients on the background, no motion blur.
